title.narrative: Office of the Special Adviser to the UN Secretary-General on Solutions to Internal Displacement

description.narrative:
In June 2022, the UN Secretary-General launched the Action Agenda on Internal Displacement. Through the Agenda, the post of Special Adviser was established as a means to strengthen efforts on durable solutions for Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs). The Special Adviser has three core responsibilities: galvanize political will through high-level and country-level advocacy; strengthen engagement of development actors, including International Financial Institutions, around solutions to internal displacement; and drive collaboration within the UN system to ensure that durable solutions are more effectively addressed within the UN’s existing processes and mechanisms.
This funding aims to support the Office to deliver four results: prevent tomorrow's displacement crisis; promote solutions-friendly, humanitarian-led responses; model development-led solutions pathways; and create the enabling environment/architecture for a new approach to solutions.
